about_the_game:
Conquer and Corrupt the Heavenly Realm as Lilith in this Frenetic Roguelike Horde Survival

Unjustly banished for defying a rotten divine order, Lilith rises from the depths of the underworld with a single goal: Corrupt the heavenly realm and restore true balance between good and evil.

Face endless hordes of celestial enemies, channel and combine the power of the Seven Deadly Sins, and transform every corner of heaven into your own domain. Only you can corrupt paradise and ascend as the supreme queen of the celestial plane.

DEMO DESCRIPTION

In this demo, play as Lilith on her journey to corrupt the Celestial realm.

  • Play the first full level

  • experience how the corruption works

  • Try and use the power of all the seven deadly sins.

  • Fight against all 5 enemies and the different tiers of each

Will you be able to conquer and corrupt the celestial realm?

Play and find out!

CORRUPT PARADISE

Unleash the devastating power of corruption and watch it spread like an unstoppable plague. Defeat celestial legions, claim territory, and transform each conquered zone into a dark reflection of your will. Control the map: the more corruption you spread, the stronger your abilities become… and the closer you get to the celestial throne.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ATTACK STYLE

Before each run, choose between two combat styles:

  • Keep your distance with long-range attacks

  • Dive into the chaos of close-quarters melee

Your fighting style changes not only your playstyle, but the challenges you face, the Sins you’ll unlock, and how you survive the divine onslaught.

WIELD THE POWER OF THE SEVEN DEADLY SINS

Throughout each run, shape your combat style by channeling and combining the power of the Seven Deadly Sins. 

Each Sin is a unique ability that transforms your way of fighting, modifying your attacks, changing how corruption affects the environment and enemies, and leaving a dark mark on the Heavenly Realm.

Combine sins, dominate the hordes, and adapt your strategy in a battlefield that’s constantly evolving.

Heaven won’t be redeemed... it will be conquered.

KNOW YOUR ENEMIES

Heaven’s champions won’t fall easily.

Each enemy type has unique patterns, abilities, and weaknesses.

Observe. Learn. Exploit. Turn divine tactics against them and twist their strength into your weapon.

STAY IN CONTROL

Survive massive waves of divine enemies.

Use corruption tactically to slow their advance and combine powerful sin abilities to always maintain the upper hand.

Wield and combine the powers of the seven deadly sins to rise as the supreme queen of the celestial plane in this action roguelike.
